decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 10.2	The erection of a rear roof extension with roof lights to front and side roof slopes of the house, as shown on drawing numbers, W60XY/Sout-130, W60XY/Sout-131, W60XY/Sout-131E, W60XY/Sout-135E, W60XY/Sout-139, received 31st August 2006 and W60XY/Sout-132 & W60XY/Sout-135, received 20th November 2006, would by reason of their size, position and appearance, not harm the appearance of the existing building or the amenity of neighbouring properties. Therefore the proposed development complies with the relevant London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan 2003 policies; ENV-B.1.1 New Development and H.6.4 Extensions and Alterations.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 5 - The roof lights hereby permitted shall be flush with the existing plane of the roof
description: Erection of a rear roof extension with roof lights to front and side roof slopes of the house
